This elder Vau was the '''Grandfather''' of [[Walon Vau]] and most likely at one time the [[Count of Gesl]]. It was said he shot and killed a servant with a [[Arakyd Special|custom blaster]], though [[Kal Skirata]] believed Vau told him of it only to anger him.
